practices.practice: Maintain comprehensive build records that tie each VIN to its specific components (axles, tires, rims, lighting, brakes) and label values.
practices.why_it_matters: Ensures inspection sign-off and label verification function as compliance steps, while keeping warranty claims, complaints, and dealer reports reviewable.

practices.practice: Use AI to prepare, check, and flag gaps in compliance paperwork while retaining a responsible person to certify final compliance.
practices.why_it_matters: Meets NHTSA self-certification obligations and helps avoid civil penalties of up to $27,168 per violation.

practices.why_it_matters: Establishes operational efficiency as the necessary foundation for automation and workforce retention without requiring upfront spending.

scored_opportunities.name: Custom Spec Validator Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Parses incoming RFQ forms, cross-references specifications against 10+ trailer models, flags incompatible combinations, and generates a preliminary quote draft.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual specification verification across 10+ models causes delays and errors.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value due to direct revenue acceleration and error reduction; moderate effort requires model database digitization; low risk as it only suggests quotes for human approval.

scored_opportunities.name: Dealer Credit & Portal Provisioning Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Automates collection of dealer applications, routes credit docs to Sheffield/Northpoint for approval, and auto-generates portal credentials upon financing acceptance.
scored_opportunities.gap: Fragmented credit application workflows and manual portal credential management slow dealer activation.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Strong value by accelerating dealer time-to-market; moderate effort due to API integration with financing partners; manageable risk as credential generation is deterministic and auditable.

scored_opportunities.name: Component Traceability & Compliance Checker Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Scans incoming component batches, matches them to VIN-specific build sheets, flags non-compliant parts against NHTSA standards, and updates digital build records.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual tracking of specialized components across custom configurations leads to compliance gaps and assembly delays.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Critical value for regulatory compliance and recall prevention; high effort due to ERP/MES integration needs; moderate risk as incorrect part flagging could halt production but is mitigated by human sign-off.

scored_opportunities.name: Lifetime Warranty Claim Processor Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Extracts data from warranty registration forms, matches them to original build specs and dealer records, auto-populates lifetime claim files, and routes complex technical tickets to engineers.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual data entry for lifetime claims and scattered support ticket tracking across diverse models.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value by reducing administrative overhead and improving customer satisfaction; low-moderate effort using standard OCR/NLP; low risk as it only drafts claims for warranty manager approval.

scored_opportunities.name: Legacy Parts Inventory Reconciler Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Continuously cross-references current sales orders with legacy parts inventory, predicts stockouts for discontinued models, and suggests alternative compatible components.
scored_opportunities.gap: Inventory tracking for legacy and current model parts is disjointed, causing shipping delays and cost overruns.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Solid value by reducing dead stock and shipping costs; moderate effort requires historical data cleaning; low risk as it only provides inventory recommendations.

scored_opportunities.name: Production Insight Synthesizer Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Aggregates customer survey responses, identifies recurring quality or feature complaints, and maps them to specific production batches or component suppliers for corrective action.
scored_opportunities.gap: Low response rates and unstructured survey insights are not integrated into production adjustments.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Moderate value by closing the feedback loop to manufacturing; low effort using standard text analysis APIs; minimal risk as it only generates reports for management review.

scored_opportunities.name: Unified Build Specification Knowledge Base Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Ingests all 10+ trailer model manuals, spec sheets, and historical RFQ data to create a searchable, structured knowledge base for all downstream agents.
scored_opportunities.gap: Disconnected spec documentation requires manual lookup across PDFs and legacy databases.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Foundational value enabling all other agents; moderate effort due to data ingestion and structuring; minimal risk as it operates read-only for internal knowledge retrieval.

scored_opportunities.name: Website AI assistant
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Greets visitors and offers starting choices (Request Quote; Contact Dealers; View Brochures), answers common questions from approved business information, and hands off to a person.
scored_opportunities.gap: No AI chatbot or chat widget was found on the pages read.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: ratings set by code (fixed defaults), not by the model

roadmaps.rationale: Beginning with customer feedback synthesis allows the company to quickly identify and fix recurring quality issues without disrupting core manufacturing workflows. Implementing the website assistant next leverages existing digital traffic to reduce manual inquiry handling, while deferring warranty processing ensures complex claims are only tackled after simpler operational insights are stabilized. This progression respects a low risk tolerance by delivering fast, low-effort improvements that build confidence before handling more intricate customer interactions.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The Production Insight Synthesizer Agent is piloted first because it requires minimal integration effort and immediately surfaces actionable quality data from existing surveys, delivering fast value with negligible operational disruption.
roadmaps.assumption: Customer survey responses are consistently collected and stored in a format that the agent can reliably aggregate and analyze.

opportunities: Unified Build Specification Knowledge Base Agent
roadmaps.rationale: Establishing the knowledge base first ensures all downstream agents have a single source of truth for specifications, preventing conflicting data from propagating through warranty and feedback systems. Implementing the warranty processor next leverages this structured data to accurately match claims with original build specs, while deferring customer feedback analysis ensures that quality insights are only generated after the core specification framework is validated. This foundational approach prevents costly rework and aligns with a cautious strategy by prioritizing data integrity before automating customer-facing or analytical processes.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The Unified Build Specification Knowledge Base Agent is piloted first because it requires no direct customer interaction or live production changes, allowing the team to safely structure critical data before automating dependent workflows.
roadmaps.assumption: All existing trailer model manuals, spec sheets, and historical RFQ data are accessible, digitized, and sufficiently standardized to be ingested into a searchable knowledge base.

roadmaps.rationale: Starting with compliance and traceability addresses regulatory risks first, which is critical for trailer manufacturing. Following with warranty processing captures high-value customer retention data before tackling custom specs, ensuring the most financially impactful processes are automated first. This sequence aligns with a cautious owner by prioritizing regulatory safety and revenue protection over experimental custom configurations.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The Component Traceability & Compliance Checker Agent is piloted first because it directly prevents costly regulatory fines and production rework, offering immediate risk mitigation for a cautious operator.
roadmaps.assumption: The business maintains accurate, digitized VIN-specific build sheets and component supplier data that can be reliably scanned by the agent.

rubric.objection: The roadmap prioritizes a high-risk, high-effort pilot project (Component Traceability & Compliance Checker Agent) above quicker wins, exceeding the owner's risk tolerance and contradicting the coded check findings.

findings.message: 'Component Traceability & Compliance Checker Agent' has risk 5/10, above the owner's limit of 4.4 and it is the pilot
the pilot ('Component Traceability & Compliance Checker Agent') is high effort (7/10); start with something quicker
